title: MV Changing troop's location in a 16:9 resolution

posts.author: coolok
posts.body:
Hello,
So uh first things first, I am new to this rpg maker stuff and it's my first time trying to make a game.
I've set the game resolution to 16 by 9 (1920 by 1080) using the
community basic
plugin that comes preinstalled and I've ran into an issue where I can move the enemies only within the upper left corner. How can I move them to the
middle of the screen
?
I've tried to change around some stuff in the js files to do so but I couldn't figure anything out.
thanks in advance

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Hmmm, haven't played around with that, but if you just need to shift the enemies in all troops, you can search for plugins here:
MV - Enemy Positions in battle.
